title: PAYWORTHY: Can LLMs Predict Which Freelance Jobs an AI Agent Will Complete?
abstract: arXiv:2611.05759v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Before an AI agent takes on a paid job, someone has to judge whether it is likely to succeed. We test whether frontier language models can make this call before any attempt. We propose PAYWORTHY which contains 1{,}494 real freelance job postings, sampled from 18.8M postings made between 2020 and 2026 on a freelancing platform. An agent attempts each job from the posting alone in a single run, and an LLM judge acting as the client decides whether to accept the work. We ask 18 models to forecast how likely the agent is to succeed and measure how well each model's forecasts rank the accepted jobs above the rejected ones (AUC, where 0.5 is a random ranking). The answer depends on how the agent is described. Told what the agent cannot do, every model ranks the jobs well (AUC 0.66--0.86). Told instead that it is a generic agent with a browser and code execution, the same models rank the same jobs about as well as a random ordering (0.45--0.56)

translated_title: PAYWORTHY：大语言模型能否预测AI智能体将完成哪些自由职业任务？
translated_abstract: 在AI智能体接手一份有偿工作之前，需要有人判断它是否可能成功。我们测试了前沿大语言模型能否在任何实际尝试之前做出这一判断。我们提出PAYWORTHY基准，其中包含1,494条真实的自由职业任务帖，这些任务从一个自由职业平台2020年至2026年间发布的1,880万条帖子中采样而来。智能体仅根据任务帖单独尝试完成每项工作（单次运行），并由一个充当客户角色的大语言模型裁判决定是否接受该工作。我们让18个模型预测智能体成功的可能性，并衡量每个模型的预测将被接受的任务排在被拒绝任务之上的能力（AUC指标，其中0.5表示随机排序）。结果表明，答案取决于如何描述该智能体：当告知模型智能体不能做什么时，所有模型都能很好地对任务进行排序（AUC为0.66-0.86）；而当仅告知它是一个具备浏览器和代码执行能力的通用智能体时，同样的模型对同样任务的排序效果几乎与随机排序无异（0.45-0.56）。
tldr: 该论文提出PAYWORTHY基准，基于1,494条真实自由职业任务发现，大语言模型只有在被告知智能体的能力限制时才能可靠预测哪些任务会被AI智能体成功完成（AUC达0.66-0.86），而若仅将其描述为通用智能体，预测效果则接近随机水平。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PAYWORTHY, a benchmark of 1,494 real freelance jobs showing that LLMs can reliably predict which jobs an AI agent will complete (AUC 0.66-0.86) only when informed of the agent's limitations, while their predictions degrade to near-random performance when the agent is described as a generic one.
